name: United Integrated Services Co., Ltd.
summary: United Integrated Services Co., Ltd. provides engineering construction services in Taiwan, Mainland China, Singapore, the United states, and Japan. It operates through Engineering and Integration Department; Maintenance and Design Department; and Other segments. The company engages in the undertaking of various water supply engineering, instrumentation engineering, and refrigeration and air conditioning engineering; installation of clean rooms and related transactions; manufacturing of supplies; designing and installation of traffic control systems; and factory computer monitoring systems.
